paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption: Left: Illustrative examples of reflection improving reasoning. Right: Quantitative comparison on benchmark datasets.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart presents a quantitative comparison of performance scores across four distinct benchmark datasets—MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics—for three different models: SRPO-7B (dark blue), GRPO-7B (medium blue), and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B (light blue). The vertical axis, labeled “Score,” is scaled linearly from 35 to 80, with gridlines and labeled tick marks at regular intervals of 5 units, and the horizontal axis, labeled “Benchmark,” lists the four datasets in the order they appear from left to right. Each benchmark has three adjacent bars representing the respective model scores, with the exact numerical values displayed above each bar. For MathVista, the scores are 75.8 for SRPO-7B, 72.3 for GRPO-7B, and 68.2 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For MathVerse, the scores are 55.8 for SRPO-7B, 52.9 for GRPO-7B, and 46.3 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For MMMU-Pro, the scores are 42.3 for SRPO-7B, 39.9 for GRPO-7B, and 36.9 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For Physics, the scores are 60.6 for SRPO-7B, 53.5 for GRPO-7B, and 45.4 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. The bars are not grouped or stacked; each model’s performance is represented by a separate bar for each benchmark, and the bars are arranged in the order of the benchmarks along the horizontal axis. There is no visual emphasis such as highlighting or shading applied to any of the bars.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图旨在通过数值比较展示三种不同模型（SRPO-7B、GRPO-7B、Qwen-2.5-VL-7B）在四个特定基准测试（MathVista、MathVerse、MMMU-Pro、Physics）上的得分表现。图表的水平轴（X轴）表示“Benchmark”，按从左至右的顺序排列了四个测试名称；垂直轴（Y轴）表示“Score”，采用线性刻度，数值范围从35到80，以5为间隔标注刻度。每个基准测试下包含三根并列的柱状图，分别对应三种模型，颜色编码如下：深蓝色代表SRPO-7B，浅蓝色代表GRPO-7B，浅灰蓝色代表Qwen-2.5-VL-7B，图例位于右上角。具体数值如下：在MathVista基准上，SRPO-7B得分75.8，GRPO-7B得分72.3，Qwen-2.5-VL-7B得分68.2；在MathVerse基准上，SRPO-7B得分55.8，GRPO-7B得分52.9，Qwen-2.5-VL-7B得分46.3；在MMMU-Pro基准上，SRPO-7B得分42.3，GRPO-7B得分39.9，Qwen-2.5-VL-7B得分36.9；在Physics基准上，SRPO-7B得分60.6，GRPO-7B得分53.5，Qwen-2.5-VL-7B得分45.4。所有柱状图均按基准测试名称从左至右排列，未按得分高低排序，且无任何柱状图被视觉强调或加粗。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart presents a quantitative comparison of three multimodal language models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across four benchmark datasets: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics, with the vertical axis labeled "Score" ranging from 35 to 80 in linear increments and the horizontal axis labeled "Benchmark" listing the datasets in left-to-right order. Each benchmark has three grouped bars, color-coded according to a legend in the top right corner: dark blue for SRPO-7B, medium blue for GRPO-7B, and light blue for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For MathVista, the scores are 75.8 for SRPO-7B, 72.3 for GRPO-7B, and 68.2 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For MathVerse, the scores are 55.8 for SRPO-7B, 52.9 for GRPO-7B, and 46.3 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For MMMU-Pro, the scores are 42.3 for SRPO-7B, 39.9 for GRPO-7B, and 36.9 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For Physics, the scores are 60.6 for SRPO-7B, 53.5 for GRPO-7B, and 45.4 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. The bars are not sorted and are visually presented with no additional emphasis such as shading or bolding, though each bar includes its exact score as a numerical label above it.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt eine quantitative Vergleichsanalyse der Leistung von drei verschiedenen Multimodalen LLMs – SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B – auf vier verschiedenen Benchmark-Datenbanken: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro und Physics. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Benchmark-Datenbanken, angeordnet in der Reihenfolge ihrer Auftritt in der Abbildung, und die vertikale Achse stellt den Score dar, der auf einer linearen Skala von 35 bis 80 skaliert ist, wobei die Achsenmarkierungen in Schritten von 5 angezeigt werden. Jeder Benchmark hat drei vertikal angeordnete Balken, die jeweils eine der drei Modelle repräsentieren: Der dunkelblaue Balken steht für SRPO-7B, der mittelblaue für GRPO-7B und der hellblaue für Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, wie in der Legende angegeben. Für den Benchmark MathVista erzielt SRPO-7B einen Score von 75.8, GRPO-7B 72.3 und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 68.2. Bei MathVerse beträgt der Score von SRPO-7B 55.8, von GRPO-7B 52.9 und von Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 46.3. Auf MMMU-Pro erreichen SRPO-7B 42.3, GRPO-7B 39.9 und Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 36.9. Für den Benchmark Physics beträgt der Score von SRPO-7B 60.6, von GRPO-7B 53.5 und von Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 45.4. Die Balken sind in der Reihenfolge der Benchmark-Datenbanken angeordnet und nicht nach Wert sortiert; es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung oder besondere Formatierung von Balken.
